title: Self-hosting LLMs on budget hardware: general principles, hardware, benchmarks and frontends
body:
I've been self-hosting LLMs on various budget hardware for a while (6x RTX 3060 12 GB, Intel Arc Pro B60 24 GB, RX 9070 XT, etc). Over the last few months, I wrote about it in 4 articles:

Hardware and inference optimization

CPU+RAM offloading, MoE, inference speed, prefill speed and benchmarks

Frontends and example of complete configuration

I hope it may be useful to some people :-)
summaryZh: 本文详细探讨了在预算有限的硬件环境下部署本地大语言模型的实践经验。作者通过对多种显卡（如RTX 3060、Intel Arc Pro B60等）的实测，总结了推理优化、CPU+RAM卸载策略、混合专家模型（MoE）的运行效率以及预填充速度等关键指标。文章为开发者提供了从硬件选型到前端配置的完整参考，是本地化部署大模型的实用指南。
